title: Read VSTest messages through the supported typed contract
goal: Read a known VSTest message through DeserializeMessage and DeserializePayload<T>; preserve platform test data, validate the protocol and replace removed Newtonsoft-based communication APIs.

selectionNotes: The tested package boundary is TestHost 18.7.0 versus 18.11.0, not a target-framework/package-major mapping.
Target10 deliberately adopts TestHost18.11.0; independent native net10 execution qualifies this conditional route and preserves the exact eight foundations.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Observed Windows x64 runtime10.0.13 or runtime11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105, separately from SDK/compiler selection.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Actual sample SDK10.0.402 and SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; compiler versions recorded by executing their real csc.dll.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared C#14/15 baseline; the typed contract does not require a new language feature.

frameworks: Microsoft.NET.Sdk framework-dependent executable for an independent advanced-host bridge; IsTestProject=false.

packages.name: Microsoft.TestPlatform.TestHost
packages.reason: Direct supported advanced-host acquisition from nuget.org; complete runtime closure is published with the bridge.

packages.name: Microsoft.TestPlatform.ObjectModel
packages.reason: Matching transitive public platform graph contract; resolved and locked, not an SDK-root reference.

packageAssets: Both actual TestHost/ObjectModel versions select lib/net8.0 compile/runtime assets on the measured net10/net11 consumers.
Old TestHost18.7.0 directly brings Newtonsoft13.0.3 lib/net6.0. Current closure has no Newtonsoft; compiler controls independently add13.0.4 without restoring removed platform APIs.

Package ZIP and deployed CommunicationUtilities SHA-256 values match the audit. NuGet-generated locks pin the selected full closure. SDK-bundled 18.11.0-release-26504-105 assemblies are separate artifacts.
platforms: Windows x64 build/publish and real independent deployed-consumer execution verified. No .NET Framework, older target, other OS/architecture or IDE injection route is claimed.
prerequisites: PowerShell7, public nuget.org access for restore and both pinned SDK/runtime installations for paired reproduction. No workloads/native toolchains/provider/device are required.
Use the complete package closure; publish the bridge and run its own DLL, not testhost.dll. Copying a communication DLL from the SDK is not this supported acquisition route.
DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH=0 in isolated CLI homes; preserve PATH and persistent environment settings.
constraints: Known original laboratory payload uses TestCase, TestObject traits, TestResult and ITestRunStatistics; both protocol1/2 graphs and cross-version wires are executed.
Message.Version is0 when protocol1 serialization omits Version;2 remains2. RawMessage is the full unchanged JSON envelope, not the payload. Header parsing alone can accept malformed payload JSON.

Bridge accepts only message kind CwmLab.BatchCompleted and negotiated versions0/1/2, validates required domain fields and rejects null/malformed payloads. This is a local protocol example, not a VSTest transport/negotiation implementation.
Use ITestRunStatistics. On actual18.11 a concrete TestRunStatistics read preserves ExecutedTests but loses its Passed count; the measured limitation is explicit.

All eight named removed contracts have old compile and current failure controls, even with explicit Newtonsoft. The note names TestPlatformContractResolver<T>; actual18.7 exports the nongeneric TestPlatformContractResolver1. No generic equivalent is invented.

No public configurable resolver/converter replacement is advertised; no internal converter is accessed. Existing custom Newtonsoft contracts need redesign outside this bounded typed graph. Adding Newtonsoft does not restore source or binary compatibility.
No test execution, adapter/collector injection, VSTest process communication, arbitrary payload compatibility, trimming or Native AOT is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: The .NET11 SDK/runtime evidence is RC2, not actual GA reconciliation; TestHost18.11.0 is the actual public stable package. No experimental API or opt-in is required.
PIN-959 qualifying coverage/evidence and PIN-963 actual-GA/Human gates remain open.
